_comment: LTX-Video 2B FLF2V workflow — first+last frame interpolation. REQUIREMENTS: ltxv-2b-0.9.8-distilled-fp8.safetensors in diffusion_models/, ltxv_vae.safetensors in vae/, ltxv_t5xxl.safetensors in clip/ (download from Lightricks/LTX-Video text_encoder/model.safetensors, ~9.5 GB). Validated with ComfyUI 0.34.0 + ComfyUI-LTXVideo official nodes (kornia>=0.7 required).

1._comment: Loads LTX-Video 2B distilled FP8 DiT model

2._comment: LTX-Video VAE — separate from the main model file

3._comment: T5-XXL text encoder for LTX-Video. Official repo is 4 shards × 5 GB (~19 GB). Use community FP8 single-file instead: hf_hub_download('comfyanonymous/flux_text_encoders', 't5xxl_fp8_e4m3fn.safetensors') → models/clip/ltxv_t5xxl_fp8.safetensors. Also symlink to models/text_encoders/ for CLIPLoader discovery.

4._comment: Positive prompt — include character trigger token

inputs.text: a fantasy warrior woman in silver armor, walking through misty forest, dramatic lighting, cinematic motion, photorealistic
worst quality, inconsistent, blurry, deformed, static, ugly

6._comment: Start frame — first keyframe of the clip

7._comment: End frame — last keyframe of the clip

8._comment: Conditions the latent on the START frame (frame 0)

9._comment: Adds the END frame as a keyframe guide (frame_idx=-1 = last frame)

10._comment: Applies frame-rate conditioning required by LTX-Video

11._comment: Patches the model with LTX-specific sampling parameters

12._comment: Creates the noise schedule for LTX-Video

13._comment: Sampling — uses patched model from ModelSamplingLTXV

15._comment: Saves to MP4. Adjust frame_rate to match LTXVConditioning frame_rate.
